blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The two city assessors presented by Vice President Sara Z. Duterte’s defense failed to establish conclusively that questioned properties in Davao City and Samal Island were allegedly properly declared in her statements of assets, liabilities, and net worth, Rep. Terry Ridon, a House prosecutor, said in a statement on Wednesday. Ridon, a House impeachment prosecutor, said discrepancies in property locations, values, and supporting documents remained unresolved despite the witnesses’ testimony before the Senate impeachment court. The defense first presented Davao City Assessor Jaime Adalin on Nov. 9 to establish that a 379-square-meter property registered under Duterte’s husband, lawyer […]...
